name: What types of windows are best suited for a kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What types of windows are best suited for a kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchens, popular window types include casement, awning, double-hung, and sliding windows, as well as bay or bow windows for added space. Casement windows offer excellent ventilation and ease of cleaning, often operated with a crank. Awning windows are great for ventilation even during light rain. Double-hung and sliding windows are versatile and common. The best choice depends on your kitchen layout, desired ventilation, and aesthetic preferences. Factors like natural light, ease of access to open, and proximity to sinks or countertops should guide your decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Casement, awning, double-hung, and sliding windows are popular for kitchens, chosen based on layout, ventilation, and style.
